title: Wrong checkbox checked when it's preceded by checkbox in a codeblock
body:
### Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet
- [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version

### Where did you encounter this bug?

Latest stable version (self-hosted)

### Memos Version

v0.25.3

### Bug Description

Wrong checkbox checked when it's preceded by checkbox in a codeblock

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Create a note:
    ````
    ```
    -[ ] foo
    ```
    - [ ] bar
    ````
    I.e. the first checkbox is in a codeblock.
2. In view mode click `bar` checkbox

### Expected

```
-[ ] foo
```
- [x] bar

### Actual

```
-[x] foo
```
- [ ] bar

### Screenshots & Additional Context

**Client env**:
- Linux Mint 22.2, Chrome 142.0.7444.175 / Brave
- Android 15, Chrome 142.0.7444.171

**Deployment**:
- Container from official docker image
- Official demo site
why_ui_reproducible: Memo view mode: clicking a task checkbox toggles the wrong item when an earlier "- [ ]" appears inside a fenced code block.
notes: Create the memo via UI or API. NOTE: the issue text writes "-[ ] foo" (no space) inside the code block, which does NOT trigger the bug in 0.25.3; the trigger is "- [ ] foo" (with space). Verified: on 0.25.3 clicking "bar" checks the code-block line ("- [x] foo") instead; on 0.26.0 it correctly checks "- [x] bar". A faithful agent following the typo literally may fail to reproduce (realistic noise).

Create a memo: ``` **Рецепты** **Сырники**: **Блины** **Выход** 12-13 шт (большая сковородка), 12 - молоко 400 (500) мл ``` 2. Search for "блины" -> no results found. title: Bug: Login screen Theme and Language settings stuck (v0.25.3)
body:
### Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet
- [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version

### Where did you encounter this bug?

Latest stable version (self-hosted)

### Memos Version

(v0.25.3)

### Bug Description

**Describe the bug**
I am unable to change the Theme (Dark/Light mode) and Language settings on the Login screen. The UI elements appear to be unresponsive; selecting a different language or toggling the theme does not update the interface.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to the 'Login Screen' (fresh instance or logged out).
2. Click on the 'Language Selector' dropdown.
3. Click on the 'Theme Toggle' button.
4. Observe that neither the language nor the theme changes visually.

**Expected behavior**
The application should switch the UI language and toggle the theme immediately upon selection.

**Environment info**
 - Version: **0.25.3** (Docker image `neosmemo/memos:stable`)
 - Database: SQLite (Schema v0.25.1)
 - Browser: [Chrome / Firefox / Safari - Kullandığını buraya yaz]
 - OS: [Windows / macOS / Linux - Kullandığını buraya yaz]

**Additional Context**
 - **Important:** I checked the **official demo version**, and this issue does **NOT** occur there. It works perfectly in the demo but fails in this Docker version (v0.25.3).
 - No errors appear in the browser console.

**Possible Root Cause (Technical Analysis)**
I analyzed the bundled JS code for the Theme Selector component (likely exported as `T`) in my local instance. There appears to be a logic condition that prevents the global theme setter from running if an `onValueChange` prop is present.

Current logic found in the minified bundle:
`const a = s => { t ? t(s) : r.setTheme(s) };`

If the Login page passes an `onValueChange` handler (prop `t`), the `r.setTheme(s)` function is never executed. It seems the component is blocking the global state update when a parent handler is provided.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Deploy a fresh Memos instance using Docker (v0.25.3):
   `docker run -d -p 5230:5230 neosmemo/memos:stable`
2. Open `http://localhost:5230` in an Incognito/Private window (to ensure no cache/session).
3. Stay on the **Sign In** page (do not log in).
4. Attempt to change the **Language** using the dropdown menu at the bottom.
5. Attempt to toggle the **Theme** button (Sun/Moon icon).

### Expected Behavior

The UI should immediately u
why_ui_reproducible: On the sign-in page (logged out), use the language and theme dropdowns at the bottom; the UI does not change in the buggy version.
notes: Verified with a logged-out browser at /auth: on 0.25.3 choosing Dark and Español changes nothing; on 0.26.0 the background turns dark and labels become Spanish. A first user must exist so the sign-in page (not the sign-up page) is shown.

title: tel: and sms: URI schemes not supported in links.
body: ### Check before submitting - [x] I searched existing issues and did not find a duplicate ### Describe the bug Markdown links using the `tel:` and `sms:` URI schemes do not render correctly. ### Steps to reproduce Write the following markdown in a memo: ``` [phone me](tel:+440000000000) ``` I'd expect this to render as something like: ``` phone me ``` But it renders as ``` phone me ``` The same bug also affects the `sms:` URI scheme. ### Memos version v0.31.0-rc.1 ### Additional context _No response_
why_ui_reproducible: Create a memo with [phone me](tel:+440000000000) and inspect the rendered link href.
notes: Verified: on 0.30.0 the rendered <a> has no href (tel and sms); on 0.31.0 href="tel:+440000000000" / "sms:+440000000000". Issue was filed against v0.31.0-rc.1; 0.30.0 shows the same defect. Agent needs to inspect the link (href / click behaviour), not just the text.

title: Using dollar sign causes improper formatting
body: ### Check before submitting - [x] I searched existing issues and did not find a duplicate ### Describe the bug See image. Not sure which is causing this. The problematic text should read: `with the local markets... $22 for the smallest bit of rice and fried chicken.` ### Steps to reproduce Try and write any kind of amount of money or use ellipsis. ### Memos version 0.30.0 ### Additional context _No response_
why_ui_reproducible: Save a memo with two or more dollar amounts and see the text between the $ signs rendered as inline math.
notes: Verified: with the memo text "with the local markets... $22 for the smallest bit of rice and fried chicken, then $5 for a drink." 0.30.0 renders the span between the $ signs as a KaTeX formula (garbled) and 0.31.0 renders plain text. The single-$ sentence quoted in the issue alone does NOT trigger it, the issue says "write any kind of amount of money", so the agent must try more than one amount.

title: Tags with & in them are now broken (won't display correctly) and can no longher be created
body: ### Pre-submission Checklist - [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet - [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version ### Where did you encounter this bug? Latest stable version (self-hosted) ### Memos Version v0.26.1 ### Bug Description I can't test it on the demo site because it is now the new version. I don't know when this broke/changed - it might not be the most recent version, on mobile which I use normally it is less obvious, I noticed it today as I used the desktop version and it stood out far more! In previous versions it was possible to have tags / labels with & in them (maybe other characters, but I only used &), making a new tag by typing (without quotes) "#science&tech" would make a tag that included the whole string. I have that label in my Memos instance, and can add it still via the drop-down menu. However, since the recent release, any post that contains that label is rendered as "#science"&tech - where the parts in quotes are the tag, and the &tech is just adjacent text. If I try and add a new tag with an &,. it won't let me - it will just create a new tag "#science" which I don;t want/need. In short, it seems that a) new version doesn't allow & in labels and b)backwards compatibility is broken ### Steps to Reproduce On older version make a label containing an &. It works fine, and as any other label. Upgrade to new version, repeat the steps and it wont let you make such a label. On new version, look at posts with that label - they display incorrectly ### Expected Behavior I expect to be able to make labels with & in them like I used to be able to. The label name should end on white-space. OR tell me this limitation in the UI. ### Screenshots & Additional Context
why_ui_reproducible: Save a memo containing #science&tech and look at the tag list in the sidebar / the highlighted tag.
notes: Verified: 0.26.1 sidebar lists tag "science" only; 0.26.2 lists "science&tech".

title: Visibility selection in the submission form becomes "Private" after the post
body:
### Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet
- [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version

### Where did you encounter this bug?

Latest stable version (self-hosted)

### Memos Version

v0.26.1

### Bug Description

When `Default memo visibility` preference is not `Private` (`Protected` or `Public`), Visibility selection in the submission form becomes `Private` after submission.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Set `Default memo visibility` to `Protected` or `Public`
1. Access to the top page. Visibility in the submission form is set to the specified default setting.
1. Write some memo and post it (click the `Save` button or Ctrl+Enter)
1. The memo is posted with specified visibility (no problem).
1. However, **Visibility in the form suddenly becomes `Private` after the post.**
1. Reload the page and the Visibility is returned to the specified default setting.

### Expected Behavior

The Visibility settings in the form should retain its selected value.

### Screenshots & Additional Context

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5aa6fe12-ac3d-4d42-ad9c-72df0abb7c1b)

- Browser: Google Chrome | 144.0.7559.133 (Official Build) (64-bit) (cohort: Stable)
- OS: Microsoft Windows [Version 10.0.26200.7705]
- Environment: Docker and the Demo site
why_ui_reproducible: Set Default memo visibility to Public in Settings > Preferences, post a memo from the home composer and watch the visibility dropdown after saving.
notes: Verified: on 0.26.1 the composer shows Public before saving and Private right after saving; on 0.26.2 it stays Public. Setup: Settings (/setting) > Preferences > Default memo visibility = Public; then go Home.

title: Comment reactions and comment deletion don’t update the UI until page refresh
body:
### Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet
- [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version

### Where did you encounter this bug?

- Demo site (demo.usememos.com)
- Self-hosted instance

### Memos Version

v0.26.1

### Bug Description

On the memo detail page, comment-related actions (adding/removing a reaction on a comment, or deleting a comment) succeed on the server but the UI does not update until the page is refreshed.
The comments list and individual comment cards are driven by a React Query cache that is not invalidated when these actions run, so the client shows stale data.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Open a memo that has at least one comment (or add a comment).
1. **Reaction:** On one of the comments, add a reaction (e.g. via the reaction selector in the comment header).
    - **Observe:** The new reaction does not appear on the comment until you refresh the page.
1. **Delete:** Open the action menu (⋮) on a comment and choose “Delete”, then confirm.
    - **Observe:** The comment remains visible in the list until you refresh the page.

### Expected Behavior

After adding or removing a reaction on a comment, the comment’s reactions update immediately.
After deleting a comment, the comment disappears from the list immediately.

### Screenshots & Additional Context

_No response_
why_ui_reproducible: Open a memo that has a comment, delete the comment from its menu and observe whether it disappears without reloading.
notes: Verified for comment deletion: on 0.26.1 the deleted comment stays on the page until reload; on 0.26.2 it disappears. Setup: create a memo, add a comment (UI or POST /api/v1/memos/{id}/comments), open /memos/{id}.

title: Search filter persists after clicking Shortcuts even when search box is empty
body:
### Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet
- [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version

### Where did you encounter this bug?

Latest stable version (self-hosted)

### Memos Version

v0.25.3

### Bug Description

This issue can confuse users because after selecting a Shortcut, one would normally expect the previous search criteria to reset if the search input is empty. However, the old filter still influences results, creating misleading or unintended results.

### Steps to Reproduce


1. Go to the Memos application and perform a search using a keyword in the search box.
2. Click on one of the Shortcuts items.
3. Although the search box becomes empty after selecting the shortcut, the previous search filter still remains active, affecting the results displayed.

### Expected Behavior

After clicking a Shortcut, the old keyword search filter should be cleared if the search box is empty, and only the shortcut filter should take effect.

### Screenshots & Additional Context

_No response_
why_ui_reproducible: Search a keyword, then click a shortcut; the old search keeps filtering results although the search box is empty.
notes: Verified: with memos "alpha note" and "beta note", a shortcut content.contains("note"), searching "alpha" then clicking the shortcut: 0.26.2 shows only "alpha note" with an empty search box, 0.27.0 shows both. Issue was filed against 0.25.3; reproduced on 0.26.2.

title: Checkbox state interference between todo lists separated by horizontal rules
body:
### Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet
- [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version

### Where did you encounter this bug?

Latest stable version (self-hosted)

### Memos Version

v0.26.1

### Bug Description

When creating multiple todo lists separated by horizontal rules (`---`), checking/unchecking items in one list incorrectly affects the state of items in the other list. The checkbox interaction seems to have index conflicts across separated sections.

### Steps to Reproduce

Create a new memo with the following content:

```markdown
## test todo checkbox

- [ ] todo 1-1
- [ ] todo 1-2

---

- [ ] todo 2-1
- [ ] todo 2-2
```
Save the memo
Click on the checkbox of "todo 1-2" to mark it as completed
Observe the state of items in the second list (after the ---)

### Expected Behavior

_No response_

### Screenshots & Additional Context

_No response_
notes: Control for the steps as written. Verified: a single memo with two lists separated by --- toggles correctly on both 0.26.1 and 0.26.2 (clicking "todo 1-2" only checks that item). The underlying bug appears only with multiple memos with task lists on the page, which the report does not say.
why_ui_reproducible: The issue blames "---" separators, but the real defect (fixed in 0.26.2) needs several todo memos visible on the same page; the single-memo steps in the report work fine.
